correctness.rationale: Modal diagonalization of an SPD H turns the common scalar iid stepsize noise into random scalar curvature A_k=lambda(1+xi_k) in each mode, with mean lambda and variance lambda²s². Each second-moment transfer uses only those two moments. Direct W=((1+beta,a),(a,1+beta))/D solves W=M W M^T+E; the positive two-step comparison sign equals vW11-1. Threshold decreases with lambda and is therefore governed by L. At boundary a fixed PSD covariance precludes convergence for all starts; above it positive-cone growth produces a diverging deterministic start. Substituting Chebyshev parameters yields 2/(sqrt(kappa)(kappa+1)); minimax GD gives 1/kappa. Independently verified exact scalar-cutoff algebra against the published random-curvature formula and the rational heavy-ball boundary.
